title: Topology of the confinement locus $\Omega(P)$
html: For simple particles, \Omega(P) is expected to be a single connected interval of \mathbb{R}_{>1} containing q_0; neither connectedness nor q_0 \in \Omega(P) is proved. For composite particles with multi-block binding, \Omega(P) can be disconnected. Each component corresponds to a distinct configuration of the active support. One physically realises transitions between components as chemical or nuclear rearrangements. Computationally, they appear as regime switches in the witness files.
